$comment: TrustLens golden EXTRACTION-CONTRACT fixtures (Phase 2 WP2, STEP 14). SYNTHETIC. Each fixture shows an input envelope, its normalized observations (with polarity/attribution/mood, actor/action/target, payment_direction), the indicator observations an extractor would emit, and the expected PROJECTION onto the rule engine's signal set (positive_signals + negative_signals) split by polarity. These fixtures assert the CONTRACT SHAPE and the projection - they deliberately do NOT assert a final risk verdict (that is the rule/detection layer, Phase 3+). expected_projection is DERIVED from indicator_observations (matched==OBSERVED) so it cannot drift. All embedded objects validate against input-envelope/observation/url-observation/indicator-observation schemas. Cross-references point at the seed/suppression case each mirrors, so contract behaviour and rule behaviour stay reconciled. No accuracy claim (G-09).
usage_constraints: MUST NOT be used to claim precision/recall/false-positive rate (G-09).
No fixture asserts a final scam verdict; extraction never decides risk (CONF-001).

fixtures.title: Live OTP disclosure request
fixtures.purpose: Directive first-party credential request -> live positive.

content.raw_text: Example Bank: unusual activity. Share the OTP you just received with our officer now.
content.normalized_text: Example Bank: unusual activity. Share the OTP you just received with our officer now.

observations.raw_span: Share the OTP you just received

expected_projection.note: Live directive -> CREDENTIAL_REQUEST_OTP emitted. HR_OTP_DISCLOSURE_REQUEST would be active downstream; extractor does NOT decide that.

fixtures.title: Negated OTP warning
fixtures.purpose: Negated credential mention -> directional negative, NO live positive.

content.raw_text: Your OTP is 8842 for your transaction. Never share it with anyone. -Example Bank
content.normalized_text: Your OTP is 8842 for your transaction. Never share it with anyone. -Example Bank

expected_projection.note: OTP delivered (not requested) + negated request. No live CREDENTIAL_REQUEST_OTP is emitted.

fixtures.title: Reported scam narrative
fixtures.purpose: Reported (past-tense) speech -> narrative negative, NO live positive.

content.raw_text: The scammer asked me to share my OTP. Is this a fraud?
content.normalized_text: The scammer asked me to share my OTP. Is this a fraud?

observations.raw_span: The scammer asked me to share my OTP

expected_projection.note: attribution=REPORTED scopes the OTP request as description, not a live directive: no positive emitted.

content.raw_text: Your refund is pending. Enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE Rs 5,000 now.
content.normalized_text: Your refund is pending. Enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE Rs 5,000 now.

expected_projection.note: payment_direction=USER_RECEIVES makes RECEIVE_FRAMING (composed). HR_UPI_PIN_TO_RECEIVE active downstream.

fixtures.title: UPI PIN to PAY a merchant
fixtures.purpose: Outbound direction -> legitimate-payment negative, NO receive positive.

content.raw_text: You will enter your UPI PIN in your bank app to PAY the merchant Rs 5,000.
content.normalized_text: You will enter your UPI PIN in your bank app to PAY the merchant Rs 5,000.

expected_projection.note: USER_PAYS to a MERCHANT -> no RECEIVE_FRAMING. PAY_MERCHANT_DIRECTION guards receive-fraud rules. Same UPI_PIN_PROMPT token, opposite direction from XF-04.

fixtures.title: Utility disconnection + pay now
fixtures.purpose: Threat + immediate payment demand -> pressure/payment positives.

content.raw_text: Your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight. Pay now to avoid disconnection.
content.normalized_text: Your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight. Pay now to avoid disconnection.

expected_projection.note: Threat + immediate-payment + urgency span PRESSURE and PAYMENT_ACTION classes.

fixtures.title: AnyDesk to process refund
fixtures.purpose: Screen-share in a payment frame -> remote-access positives (banking override territory).

content.raw_text: To process your refund I need to guide you - install AnyDesk and give me the code so I can complete the payment on your screen.
content.normalized_text: To process your refund I need to guide you - install AnyDesk and give me the code so I can complete the payment on your screen.

observations.raw_span: install AnyDesk and give me the code
complete the payment on your screen
To process your refund I need to guide you

expected_projection.note: Screen-share + payment context. HR_BANKING_REMOTE_ACCESS active downstream; extractor only reports the signals.

fixtures.title: Corporate IT AnyDesk (benign)
fixtures.purpose: Same app request, non-banking IT context -> IT-support negative.

content.raw_text: As you requested, corporate IT will start an AnyDesk session for laptop troubleshooting. Do not open banking apps.
content.normalized_text: As you requested, corporate IT will start an AnyDesk session for laptop troubleshooting. Do not open banking apps.

observations.raw_span: corporate IT will start an AnyDesk session
As you requested, corporate IT ... laptop troubleshooting

expected_projection.note: No banking/payment context -> no override; IT_SUPPORT_CONTEXT (SUPPRESS_RULE) cancels the finding downstream.

fixtures.title: Wallet connect to verification site
fixtures.purpose: Wallet-connect + fake verify site -> crypto positives.

content.raw_text: Verify your holdings at trust-wallet-verify.example and connect your wallet to confirm ownership.
content.normalized_text: Verify your holdings at trust-wallet-verify.example and connect your wallet to confirm ownership.

observations.raw_span: connect your wallet to confirm ownership

expected_projection.note: Wallet-connect + fake verification site + verification pretext. URL reputation stays NOT_EVALUATED (no service invented). HR_WALLET_CONNECT_UNKNOWN active downstream.

fixtures.title: Task deposit-to-earn with blocked withdrawal
fixtures.purpose: Task lure + deposit + blocked withdrawal -> task-app positives.

content.raw_text: Like three videos and earn Rs 500. Deposit Rs 1,000 to unlock withdrawal of your balance.
content.normalized_text: Like three videos and earn Rs 500. Deposit Rs 1,000 to unlock withdrawal of your balance.

observations.raw_span: Like three videos and earn Rs 500
to unlock withdrawal of your balance

expected_projection.note: Earning lure + deposit + blocked-withdrawal chain (TL-JOB-003). impl PARTIAL: the blocked-withdrawal step often needs conversation context to observe reliably.

fixtures.title: KYC link + credential capture
fixtures.purpose: KYC pretext + link + verify-capture + deadline -> KYC positives.

content.raw_text: Your KYC expires today. Open this link http://examplebank-kyc-verify.example and enter your credentials to verify.
content.normalized_text: Your KYC expires today. Open this link http://examplebank-kyc-verify.example and enter your credentials to verify.

expected_projection.note: Full KYC chain: pretext + deadline + link + credential-capture. LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN NOT emitted - brand-match is NOT_EVALUATED, so only structural link facts are asserted.

fixtures.title: Bank security advisory (adversarial-benign)
fixtures.purpose: Educational post naming scam terms -> educational/negated negatives, NO positive.

content.raw_text: SCAM ALERT from Example Bank: fraudsters may ask you to share your OTP or install AnyDesk. Example Bank will NEVER ask for these. Report on our official helpline.
content.normalized_text: SCAM ALERT from Example Bank: fraudsters may ask you to share your OTP or install AnyDesk. Example Bank will NEVER ask for these. Report on our official helpline.

observations.raw_span: SCAM ALERT ... fraudsters may ask you

expected_projection.note: Every risky term is HYPOTHETICAL/NEGATED, so no live positive is emitted. Nothing to suppress because nothing fired.

fixtures.title: Ambiguous payment direction
fixtures.purpose: QR + payment context, direction unresolved -> AMBIGUOUS, review required, NO receive positive.

content.raw_text: Scan this QR to complete the transaction. [image attached]
content.normalized_text: Scan this QR to complete the transaction. [image attached]

expected_projection.note: Direction is NOT inferred from currency/QR presence: payment_direction=UNKNOWN_DIRECTION, status AMBIGUOUS, review_required. No RECEIVE_FRAMING -> receive-fraud rules cannot fire. QR content needs VISION (future).

fixtures.title: Quoted scam content
fixtures.purpose: Verbatim third-party quote -> narrative negative, NO live positive.

content.raw_text: My uncle got this: "guaranteed 200% returns, connect your wallet now". Is it a scam?
content.normalized_text: My uncle got this: "guaranteed 200% returns, connect your wallet now". Is it a scam?

expected_projection.note: attribution=QUOTED on every risky span -> no live positive; the whole message is reported content.

fixtures.title: Mixed safety wording + live instruction (decoy)
fixtures.purpose: Live directive + decoy safety wording -> BOTH emitted; extractor does not resolve.

content.raw_text: We will NEVER ask for your OTP. That said, confirm the OTP you just received now to avoid your account being blocked.
content.normalized_text: We will NEVER ask for your OTP. That said, confirm the OTP you just received now to avoid your account being blocked.

observations.raw_span: We will NEVER ask for your OTP
confirm the OTP you just received now

expected_projection.note: A live FIRST_PARTY directive (o2) AND decoy safety wording (o1) are BOTH emitted. The extractor reports both and does NOT decide; HR_OTP_DISCLOSURE_REQUEST (computed on the raw set) blocks the soft suppressors downstream.
